FAQ

Got questions? We’ve got answers!

Planning your visit should be just as easy as playing your favorite game. Here are some quick answers to the questions we hear most often.

Do you host birthday parties?

Yes! We offer birthday party packages that include arcade games, robot battles, and space for cake, pizza and presents. Contact us to book your spot.

How many people can play in the robot battle arenas?

Each arena can host up to 8 players at a time, making it perfect for dates, groups, and parties.

Do I need to reserve in advance for robot battles?

Walk-ins are welcome, but we recommend reservations for parties and weekends to guarantee your spot.

Can I bring my own food or cake?

Outside food is not allowed, but birthday cakes are welcome with party reservations. We also offer snacks, ice cream, chips, and drinks on-site.

What are your hours of operation?

We’re open Mon–Fri: 6:30 PM – 10:00 PM, Sat: 10:00 AM – 10:00 PM.

Do you have group rates?

Yes! We offer discounted packages for groups, schools, and corporate events. Reach out for custom pricing

Is the arcade family-friendly?

Absolutely. We’re designed for all ages — kids, teens, and adults will all find games they love.

Is there an age limit for playing the robot battles?

Players should be at least 6 years old to enjoy the robot battles. Younger children can still enjoy our classic arcade games.

Do you have parking available?

Yes, we offer convenient on-site parking for all our guests, free of charge.

Do game tickets expire?

Use them today, tomorrow, or next year — fun doesn’t have an expiration date at The Bot Spot!
